name: Comandante C40
details: Hand grinder; settings counted in clicks from zero (burrs closed).

grindRanges.scale: clicks from zero (burrs closed), standard MK4 axle

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 2–8, espresso 7–13, moka pot 14–24, AeroPress 12–35, V60 15–25, filter coffee machine 12–33, French press 26–40, cold brew 30–40. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Red Clix axles count roughly twice the clicks.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
